description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend rate of Cess for Wheat or Meslin flour, of  wheat Rs. 15 per kg w.e.f. 02.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the rate of Cess under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. While it mentions Minister Malik Samarawickrama, it does so only in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation to modify regulatory requirements (cess rates), rather than focusing on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about implementing a regulatory change through statutory authority.
